data.name: Mail_account-deleted_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
as you confirmed, your myLife account and vault have been deleted for good.

data.name: Mail_account-deleted_subject
data.value: Your myLife account has been deleted

data.name: Mail_account-locked_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has locked your myLife account. You cannot sign in for now. Your data remains unchanged and encrypted.
If you do not know why, please contact the administrator.

data.name: Mail_account-locked_subject
data.value: Your myLife account has been locked

data.name: Mail_account-unlocked_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has unlocked your myLife account. You can sign in again.

data.name: Mail_account-unlocked_subject
data.value: Your myLife account has been unlocked

data.name: Mail_deletion-request_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has requested to delete your myLife account. This deletes your vault with all entries and documents for good.
Only if you agree, open this link and confirm there: {link}
The link is valid for {days} days. If you do nothing, your account remains.

data.name: Mail_footer
data.value: This message was sent automatically by myLife ({instance}).

data.name: Mail_invitation-accepted_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{invitee} has accepted your invitation and created a myLife account.
Sign in to myLife. Your browser then automatically checks that {invitee}'s key really belongs to your invitation.

data.name: Mail_invitation_body
data.value:
Hello,
{inviter} invites you to myLife, the family's digital emergency folder. In it you record what your relatives need to know in an emergency, encrypted and readable only by you until you share something.
Open this link to set up your account: {link}
The link is valid for {days} days. You need about ten minutes, a printer or pen and paper, and an authenticator app on your phone.
If you do not know {inviter}, simply ignore this email.

data.name: Mail_test_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
this test message shows that myLife can send emails.

data.name: Mail_trustee-added_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
{owner} has named you as a trusted person on myLife. What you may see in an emergency stays encrypted until it is released. If {owner} already shares something with you today, you will find it under "Shared with me" after signing in.

data.name: Mail_trustee-added_subject
data.value: {owner} has named you as a trusted person

data.name: Mail_twofactor-reset_body
data.value:
Hello {name},
an administrator has reset the two-factor sign-in of your myLife account. The authenticator app and passkeys have been removed. At your next sign-in, after the master password, you set up an authenticator app again.
If you did not ask for this, please contact the administrator immediately.
